# Tom Coles

Tom Coles is the current Deputy of [District 6](https://flow.je/elections/district-6) and a member of [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). He was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Tom Coles has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/tom-coles#e42)

  Not elected.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/tom-coles-2/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3HtPT7AlFQo)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/tom-coles#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 6 with 40.5% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/tom-coles/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NqYznGNat8A)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=40)

Tom Coles has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 6](https://flow.je/elections/district-6), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/24/st-helier-deputy-launches-re-election-bid/)\]

Links for Tom Coles:

- Facebook : [@TomColesStHelier](https://www.facebook.com/TomColesStHelier)

## Election History

### 2018 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Saviour No 3](https://flow.je/elections/st-saviour-no-3) (1 seat), 16th May 2018.

**Tom Coles was not elected**.

| 4 | Tom Coles | [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey) | 100 | 9.3% |
